robot.name: EngineAI PM01
robot.status_notes: Launched as a lightweight, highly-dynamic, fully-open embodied intelligent agent. The Robot Report reported release for commercial and educational use in late December 2024. FIRGELLI review describes it as an accessible bipedal platform for research and demos, with commercial readiness 5.5/10. No named customer deployments found.

height.notes: Identical 138 cm height on EngineAI official site PM01 card.

payload.notes: Payload not published in reviewed sources.

runtime.notes: Reported by Robotic Gizmos, added 2026-10-29 by automated spec fill.

battery.notes: Battery capacity not published in reviewed sources.

degrees_of_freedom.notes: Total DOF 24 per EngineAI official site PM01 card and The Robot Report.

compute.description: The robot's computing suite is based on X86 architecture and NVIDIA Jetson Orin high-performance modules, supporting cross-platform algorithm deployment.

actuators.description: Peak torque density of 130 N·m/kg per EngineAI official site.

availability.notes: No official price found in reviewed sources. Third-party YouTube video title says $13,700. The Robot Report mentions 88,000 yuan price in context of the SE01, not PM01. FIRGELLI review says 'Quoted and shown; verify current shop listing and export support.'

manipulation_dexterity.summary: No manipulation demos, hand specifications, or grasping evidence found. PM01 is presented as a research platform for motion demos rather than fine manipulation.
caveats: No hand information found.
No manipulation video or task success data found.

autonomy_task_execution.summary: No autonomous task execution evidence found. Motion demos and video titles do not disclose autonomy. FIRGELLI review rates autonomy confidence low to medium and says demos are motion demos, not independent task studies.
caveats: No disclosed autonomous task execution.
No independent task studies.

mobility_whole_body_control.summary: Official specs list 2 m/s walking speed and 320-degree waist rotation. Video titles claim dancing and front flipping demonstrations. Official introduction video also exists.
caveats: Video content not independently verified; only titles available.
Front flip and dancing are claimed in video titles, no transcripts or technical confirmation.

perception_scene_understanding.summary: No sensors or perception algorithms disclosed. Compute is x86 plus NVIDIA Jetson Orin.
caveats: No sensor list published.
No perception benchmarks or demos.

human_interaction.summary: The Robot Report describes a control interface inspired by Iron Man with a core screen integrating various functions to issue commands and access information.
caveats: No demonstrated interactive reliability or command-following evidence.

endurance_reliability.summary: No runtime, battery, payload, failure rate, or reliability data found.
caveats: No endurance or reliability disclosure.

human_environment_fit.summary: PM01 is compact at 1.38 m and about 40 kg, described as lightweight, highly dynamic, and open. It is intended for labs and demos.
caveats: Small size may limit human-scale task usefulness.
No safety certification or home deployment evidence.

deployment_commercial_proof.summary: Launched for commercial and educational use according to The Robot Report and listed on EngineAI official site. FIRGELLI review gives commercial readiness 5.5/10 and says it is a real small humanoid vendor.
caveats: No named customer or units deployed disclosed.
Not verified with end-user production output.

accessibility_value.summary: PM01 is an open-platform, purchasable research robot with a product page on EngineAI site. Third-party video title says $13,700. FIRGELLI confirms it is aimed at labs that want a cheaper biped.
caveats: Price originates from a third-party video title, not official pricing.
The Robot Report's 88,000 yuan price belongs to SE01, not PM01.

researcher_notes.short_verdict_for_arena: EngineAI PM01 is a compact, purchasable research humanoid with official 1.38 m/40 kg/24 DOF specs and dynamic motion video titles. There is no evidence of autonomous task execution, manipulation dexterity, endurance or named customer deployments, so confidence should remain low.
strongest_positive_evidence: Official specs from The Robot Report and EngineAI product page.
Third-party video titles suggest dancing and front flip demos.
weakest_or_missing_evidence: No payload, runtime, battery, hand or sensor disclosure.
No autonomous task execution or manipulation evidence.
No named customer deployments or production metrics.
No independently verified dynamic demos; only titles.
conflicting_claims: Price: third-party video title says $13,700; The Robot Report's 88,000 yuan price belongs to SE01, not PM01.
Dynamic capability: front flip/dancing only in video titles, not verified transcripts.
T800 video is a different robot and must not be credited to PM01.
do_not_overclaim: Do not credit PM01 with SE01 pricing or metrics.
Do not credit T800 video or capabilities to PM01.

Do not claim payload/runtime/hand specs beyond official sources.

arena_prompt_summary.one_paragraph_summary: EngineAI PM01 is a compact Chinese bipedal research humanoid listed as 1.38 m, about 40 kg, 24 DOF, 2 m/s, with 320-degree waist rotation and a third-party video title claiming a front flip. Official sources confirm the platform and an official introduction video, but no payload, runtime, battery, hands, sensors, autonomy task execution, manipulation, or named customer deployments have been found. Price is uncertain: a third-party video title says $13,700, while a commonly cited 88,000 yuan launch price belongs to SE01, not PM01. Treat as a purchasable motion/research platform with low confidence on reliability and commercial readiness.
strongest_evidence: Official PM01 specs from EngineAI product page and The Robot Report.
Third-party video titles suggest dancing and front flip demos.
FIRGELLI review confirms a real small humanoid vendor with commercial readiness 5.5/10.
weakest_evidence: No payload, runtime, battery, hand or sensor data.
No autonomous task execution or manipulation evidence.
Dynamic video titles unverified; no transcripts.
known_do_not_credit: SE01 price or metrics to PM01.
